Title: Azure Virtual Machines NVv2 meter name change

Body.Content:
Effective July 1, 2019, the meter names for Azure Virtual Machines NVv2 will change. We will make a small modification to the resource name for the NVv2 virtual machines which is currently in preview. If you are participating in the NVv2 preview you may need to modify your scripts or automated billing routines that rely on resource names.

Additionally, based on customer feedback we have recently launched NVv3 series in preview. Customers who are using NVv2 preview are encouraged to move to NVv3 preview and take advantage of hyper-threaded configurations.

You should have already received a detailed notification about the VM series name change and the action you need to take to migrate to NVv3. If you have not received the notification, then please contact Azure Support for more information.

See the tables below for name change details.
